ModMetaData.name: No One Left Behind (1.6)
ModMetaData.author: Nina.Goblin
ModMetaData.description:
This is an update of SaberVS7's update of the original mod: SaberVS7 (1.2-1.5) - https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2879457494 Captain Muscles (1.2-1.3) - https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2401146569
Would you sit idly by and leave your friends to die? Now your enemies won't either (maybe).
No One Left Behind enables your enemies to rescue their fallen allies when fleeing a battle.
I just Nina Goblined it to 1.6 ♥ This isn't mine.
